notes: All 25 candidates are individual records in the ScholarWorks@UMass Amherst 'Masters Theses 1896 - February 2014' collection (ETDS > THESES > N). Every record states a master's degree (M.A., M.S., M.S.E.C.E. or M.S.M.E.) awarded 2007-2009 in a department outside operations/management (languages and literatures, history, psychology, public health, marine sciences, electrical/computer or mechanical engineering); the one business-school record (theses/317, Hotel & Tourism Management) is also an M.S. None lists doctoral graduates or placements, so none is a program-list or a doctoral single-record. Institution by host (University of Massachusetts Amherst) is correct for all. Doctoral records at this repository live under /dissertations/ or /dissertations_1/, not /theses/, so further /theses/ candidates can be expected to be master's records.
